item.title: Sound Transit changing seats after WA rider feedback
item.description: Feedback from riders showed strong dissatisfaction with the seats on Seattle's light rail trains, and Sound Transit listened. The agency announced a sweeping change coming soon.

item.title: WA bill could ban law enforcement from wearing face coverings
item.description: A proposal to ban law enforcement, federal agents and immigration officers from wearing face coverings received its first hearing in the Washington Senate Law and Justice Committee.

item.title: Seattle weather: Foggy mornings ahead
item.description: We are in store for an amazing stretch of weather, almost early spring-like! We will be rain free for the week and into the MLK Holiday weekend.

item.title: Why the "Dark Side" defense of the Seattle Seahawks is the best in the NFL
item.description: It would be natural to compare the ‘Legion of Boom’ defense of last decade and the standout unit the Seahawks have this season. But how the defenses express their dominance couldn't be more different.

item.title: How the Seahawks got their name 50 years ago
item.description: Fifty years ago, the Seattle Seahawks got its name through a radio competition where fans got the chance to choose a name.

item.title: WA Gov. Ferguson calls for millionaires’ tax in State of the State address
item.description: Gov. Bob Ferguson used his State of the State address to call for a new tax on Washington’s wealthiest earners, propose housing investments and sharply condemned federal immigration enforcement.

item.title: Seattle U-District's Varsity Theatre announces closure
item.description: The Varsity Theatre, one of the oldest theaters in Seattle's University District, is closing on Thursday, Jan. 15, it was announced this week.

item.title: Man with machete arrested after standoff in Seattle's University District
item.description: Seattle police arrested a 47-year-old man armed with a machete after an hours-long standoff Tuesday night.

item.title: Former Bothell city councilmember pleads guilty to 2024 killing
item.description: A former Bothell city councilmember has pleaded guilty in the death of his 20-year-old girlfriend, who was killed back in April 2024.

item.title: Dozens rally at Tacoma City Hall demanding ICE to leave
item.description: Dozens packed a Tacoma City Council meeting Tuesday night, demanding they kick ICE out of the city. Before they packed the meeting, they first rallied outside city hall.
